LESSON: TIME, DISTANCE AND SPEED

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: GRADE
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.5: Time, Distance and Speed
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, Distance and Speed, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How do we relate distance, time and speed? 2. Why is speed important in daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time, Distance and Speed together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: as the learner creates conversion tables, relate and determine distance, time

and speed.

● Self-efficacy: Personality skills; as the learner observes punctuality in attending to different activities.

Values

● Responsibility: As the learner observes road safety rules, including speed limits.

● Integrity: As the learner observes punctuality and works out correct distances.
